doc: Every action the game plays as a timed sequence: spell casts, weapon attacks, abilities (the double jump, the dodge, blink), item uses and creature attacks. Their timing: when a cast releases what it spawns, when a hit lands, when the cost is paid and when a buff is applied. Costs themselves are the item's (items.manaCost, items.staminaCost); the game has no cooldown for players beyond this timing.

ids.mod: (none: a mod adds an ability as a kiln.gamedata sequence clone or an ability block)
ids.rule: The stable name starts as the name of the ability's first part in lower case (Attack_Player_Staff_FixedAnim_Fireball_fast is game:attack_player_staff_fixedanim_fireball_fast). When two abilities would get the same name, the one that held it first keeps it and the other is game:<name>~<first 8 hex digits of its GUID>.

timing.doc: When the ability does things, in seconds from its start. Each field is the first such moment of the ability; every event of the same kind at that moment moves with it, and the others stay where they are. The next time the ability plays takes the new time. An ability without such a moment refuses the edit; a time after the ability ends never comes.

release.doc: When the ability releases what it spawns: a spell's projectile, a thrown item, a summon.

hit.doc: When the ability's first hit or area effect starts (a weapon swing's hit, a slam's area).

cost.doc: When the ability pays its cost (mana, stamina, a charge of the item).

buff.doc: When the ability applies its first buff.

entry.removeDoc: Abilities cannot be added or removed through the registry: kiln.gamedata sequence clones and ability blocks add abilities.
